issues.description: new Array(size).fill(new Array(size).fill(0)) evaluates the inner array ONCE and fills every row with a reference to that same array. All rows are aliased: cells[0][0] = 1 also sets cells[1][0], cells[2][0], … The board's rows are not independent. Needs Array.from({length: size}, () => new Array(size).fill(0)).
